name: @yunari/host
description: PC host: CLI launcher, static serving, sample transport and hardware providers.
//: Runtime dependencies are few, deliberately. Serving is node:http (and node:https for the secure origin), the sample stream is Server-Sent Events over that same server rather than a `ws` dependency (telemetry is push-only, so WebSocket's bidirectionality would be unused), and baseline telemetry is node:os. node-forge is one addition: the host issues its own local CA, and Node can key and sign a certificate but cannot encode one. undici 7.30.1 (MIT) is the other: it pins a custom source's checked address to the connection that fetches it. @types/* are types-only. react and react-dom are devDependencies that never reach the Node host: `vite.admin.config.ts` bundles them into the chooser's `dist/admin`, and the player bundle stays React-free. Adding a runtime dependency here needs a THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md entry first.
